_doc: Component catalog: the machine-readable source of 'how risky is this code'. Tier is a property of the COMPONENT (blast radius), never of the tool or the builder. Owned by the component team, changed via PR + CODEOWNERS.

tiers.0: Money movement / cardholder data. Failure = Sev-1, regulatory exposure.
tiers.1: Revenue logic and guest PII. Failure = wrong prices, privacy incident.
tiers.2: Guest-facing UI. Failure = lost conversion; cheap to revert.
